Stock +14.7% at Rs 10.33 on 6.2x volume.

candidates_considered.name: Adroit Industries (India) Ltd
candidates_considered.verdict: RESEARCHED, NOT PUBLISHED - the press release reports only QoQ, and the YoY does not clear the bar. Listed on BSE on 30-Sep-2026 (new-listing notice), so 20 trading sessions of history and no 1m/3m/6m return at all. CONSOLIDATED, from the filing (Rs mn): Q2 FY27 revenue 426.73 vs Q2 FY26 360.08 = +18.5% YoY (the release headlines '+25%', which is QoQ against Q1's 341.14); PAT 85.47 vs 49.74 = +71.8%. H1 FY27 revenue 767.87 vs 692.31 = +10.9% only; PAT 160.36 vs 106.41 = +50.7%. FY26 1,399.43 / 261.58. STANDALONE tells a different story: Q2 revenue 126.13 vs 156.63 = MINUS 19.5%, H1 211.20 vs 268.64 = MINUS 21.4%, PAT flat - so the growth is all in subsidiaries and the listed entity's own operations shrank. Trailing twelve-month consolidated PAT Rs 31.55 cr on a Rs 753 cr market cap = 23.9x, no discount. And the gross margin (revenue less materials, purchases and inventory change) is 65.4% -> 69.7% for a forged-driveshaft maker, which the filing does not explain. Guidance exists - 'peak annual revenue of Rs 2,500 million' after full ramp-up by Q4 FY28, against Rs 143 cr trailing - but H1 revenue growth of 10.9% does not support paying 24x for it today. Revisit after Q3 and a concall.
